content.about: Ethiopia is a landlocked country in the Horn of Africa, with high mountains, deep valleys and the Rift Valley. It was never colonised for long and has its own ancient alphabet and calendar. It is believed to be the birthplace of coffee. Lalibela has churches carved out of solid rock.

standout.text: "Lucy", one of the most famous early human ancestor fossils, was found in Ethiopia.

didYouKnow: Coffee is thought to have first been found in Ethiopia.
Lalibela's rock-hewn churches date from around 1200.
